rationale: Evaluating omission of required braking requires characterising both the need to brake and whether the required braking response occurs. H-1, SG-1 and FR-7 establish that response as part of the phenomenon itself. H-1’s stopping-in-time condition and FR-7.1 support characterising when braking begins. The scope includes detection as a response-triggering condition, without incorporating sensing, computation or communication mechanisms.
determining_elements: “The vehicle’s need to brake” identifies the condition against which omission of a required maneuver is evaluated.
“The braking response relevant to avoiding collision” is directly supported by the evaluation target, SG-1 and FR-7.
The declared driving conditions and pedestrian crossing 20 m ahead match H-1’s operational situation.

Detected-obstacle states and “whether and when to initiate braking” concern the required response and its initiation, supported by H-1 and FR-7.1, rather than internal detection or decision-making mechanisms.
